line_or_context: 119: artillery_desc:0 "Long-range bombardment with heavy munitions intimidates and scatters enemy forces without risking your own troops. Inaccurate, slow-moving, and expensive, yet a crucial ingredient in any modern army."
95: atmospheric_engine_desc:0 "The Atmospheric Engine is the first steam engine that has an actual practical application. "
97: automatic_bottle_blowers_desc:0 "By automating the process of blowing the glass into a bottle shape, it is possible to make many more bottles a day."

279: automatic_machine_guns_desc:0 "The machine gun takes the concept of the handcranked machine gun and cranks it up a notch, replacing the human rotation with an automated system to allow for more bullets to be fired even faster."
532: baking_powder_desc:1 "Baked goods have been around since the dawn of civilization, but only with the advent of baking powder has baking at an industrial scale become truly possible."

584: banking_desc:1 "A vast financial institution, the bank provides security for public and private interests, and can become the centerpiece of a vast monetary network of investments, loans, and opportunities."
99: battlefleet_tactics_desc:0 "Operating a large battlefleet can be a difficult task. By practicing and learning specific tactics as a fleet, greater performance can be achieved."
101: battleship_tech_desc:0 "By taking the dreadnought design and making all the guns high caliber, as well as some other changes, it is possible to make an even more devastating warship."
628: behaviorism_desc:1 "Establishing the law of effect, it becomes possible to create a predictive model of behavior that can be applied to the public at large."
103: bessemer_process_desc:0 "The Bessemer process is a technique for the mass production of steel from pig iron."

127: camera_desc:0 "Through a complex chemical process it is possible to capture reality itself in a single moment. An instant painting."
131: canneries_desc:0 "Canneries are machines made specifically to seal food in an airtight container, so that it can be preserved for longer."
137: carrier_tech_desc:0 "By designing large ships with a large flat deck and equipping them appropriately, it is possible to create a sea borne airfield."

526: central_archives_desc:1 "A modern state requires good record-keeping, and good record-keeping requires thorough paperwork. If you wish to learn more, please fill form ML-4.11866 in triplicate and expect a reponse in 2-5 working days."
596: central_banking_desc:1 "Harnessing and centralizing the banks brings an immense amount of power into the hands of the government."

157: central_planning_desc:1 "Leveraging all the latest innovations in management science and electric communication, long-term plans for sweeping societal development can be coordinated by a single administrative office."

125: centralization_desc:0 "By centralizing administrative tasks within a logical hierarchy, standards of government operation can be developed that put achievements previously thought impossible within reach."
115: chemical_bleaching_desc:0 "Through the addition of certain salts, minerals, or chemicals to the raw materials, the visual qualities of manufactured goods can be greatly increased."
145: chemical_warfare_desc:0 "Certain chemical combinations produce adverse or even fatal effects when humans are exposed to them. Weaponizing this brings a whole new horrific aspect to warfare. "

147: civilizing_mission_desc:0 "It falls on our great nation's shoulders to shine the light of modernity into every uncivilized corner of the world, to educate and instill in the less developed peoples the divine values of our glorious culture."
149: colonization_desc:0 "As a population grows, it becomes possible to go elsewhere and find new mainly unclaimed land for the taking. "
155: combustion_engine_desc:0 "A combustion engine allows fuel to be turned directly into mechanical power, based on combustions taking place inside the engine constantly."
161: compression_ignition_desc:1 "A compression ignition engine ignites the fuel by compressing air and has the highest thermal efficiency of any engine."
163: concrete_dockyards_desc:0 "Sturdy and cheap, concrete allows for the construction of far larger piers that are able to support far heavier freight loads."
165: concrete_fortifications_desc:0 "By introducing concrete into fortifications it is possible to make strong entrenched positions very quickly."
171: conveyors_desc:0 "By applying motors to belts it is possible to create platforms that move goods along them without the use of human labor."
598: corporate_charters_desc: "Companies whose assets and incomes are separate from that of their owners and investors, thereby mitigating personal risks while encouraging entrepreneurship."

604: corporate_management_desc: "By synergistically introducing higher degrees of streamlining, professionalization, and scientification within our existing corporate culture, we can expect to leverage substantially maximized revenue and collaboratively evolve the industry through ...
634: corporatism_desc:0 "An approach towards social relations based on collaboration between different corporate groups in society, with the ultimate goal of superseding conflict between classes."
173: cotton_gin_desc:0 "The cotton gin is a machine which quickly separates the cotton from its seeds, enabling a much faster processing time than doing it by hand."
277: crystal_glass_desc:0 "By adding lead to glass it is possible to create glass with the appearance of crystal, which is sought after due to its value."
304: currency_standards_desc:0 "By establishing a standardized currency the population can be taxed in a uniform fashion, collecting tax via currency rather than labor or goods."
179: defense_in_depth_desc:0 "By making multiple lines of defense, it is possible to spread out and slow down the enemy and sometimes even envelop them."
181: democracy_desc:0 "Democracy is at its heart the idea that the population of a country get to choose how their country is run, through voting or other means. "

578: destroyer_desc:1 "Lighter vessels, equipped with torpedoes and smaller guns, are just as important in modern navies as capital ships."
606: dialectics_desc:1 "Applying philosophical concepts to material conditions produces may create novel concepts, and perhaps new political ideas."
183: distillation_desc:0 "Distillation is the ability to separate components of a liquid using different boiling temperatures, allowing for all sorts of further uses."
552: dough_rollers_desc:1 "To produce all the food demanded by a rapidly-growing population, traditional bakers won't suffice any longer."
190: dreadnought_tech_desc:0 "By making a warship with only heavy caliber guns and steam propulsion, it is possible to overpower all other types of ship."
318: drydocks_desc:0 "Creating enclosed areas where ships can be docked on dry land allows for easier and more thorough maintenance of cargo vessels and warships alike."
193: dynamite_desc:0 "By applying a stabilizing agent to nitroglycerin it is possible to make a much safer and more reliable explosive."

195: egalitarianism_desc:0 "Egalitarianism is the doctrine of the equality of mankind and the desirability of political, economic and social equality."
197: electric_arc_process_desc:0 "By putting an electric arc through metal it is possible to smelt it more quickly and efficiently."
199: electric_railway_desc:0 "By using electricity to power the trains rather than steam, it is possible to have a much more reliable rail system."

566: electric_telegraph_desc:1 "Through the use of simple electric pulses, messages can be rapidly transmitted through codes across vast distances. Officers in a stuffy office can send commands to armies on the far side of the world instantaneously. What hath God wrought?"
632: electrical_capacitors_desc:0 "Electrical Capacitors allow for the increased usage of electricity without the necessity of having a directly connected generator."
201: electrical_generation_desc:0 "It is possible to capture the very essence of lightning and use it to power all sorts of different types of machinery."
203: elevator_desc:0 "Through a complex system of weights and pulleys, it possible to raise people and objects to desired heights at will."
205: empiricism_desc:0 "An epistemological philosophy deriving knowledge from empirical evidence, information gathered from experiences rather than cultural norms or religious beliefs."

416: enclosure_desc:0 "The merger of subsistence plots into enclosed, privately owned fields permits for more organized agriculture and the use of arable land for growing cash crops rather than food."
568: enlistment_offices_desc:1 "Offices built to attract recruits help immensely with bolstering the nation's military manpower."

109: feminism_desc:0 "Feminism is an ideology concerned with advancing social, economic, and political equality for women. Feminists believe that women should have the same legal rights as men to own property, work, and participate in politics."
211: field_works_desc:0 "Field works is modifying the terrain where the battle is held thus giving soldiers greater protection."
213: film_desc:0 "By taking many photographs in quick succession, it is possible to capture movement in real time. This can then be processed and played back."
582: flamethrowers_desc:1 "A great way to drive entrenched soldiers out of their defensive positions is to light a fire under them."
215: flash_freezing_desc:0 "By subjecting food to a very low temperature, it can be quickly frozen, allowing it to be preserved for longer."

217: floating_harbor_desc:0 "By keeping a dock at a constant level along a tidal waterway, ships can more quickly dock and transfer goods without having to consider relative changes between the waterway level and docks."
223: fractional_distillation_desc:0 "Repeated vaporizing and condensing allows the liquids to be separated into purer components. The practical applications of this process are endless."

231: gantry_cranes_desc:0 "Useful in construction and transportation, gantry cranes are large enough to straddle the width of a ship. This gives them a sturdiness that means they can lift the heaviest loads a ship can possibly carry."

233: general_staff_desc:0 "Having a set of officers to act as a conduit between the high command and the troops themselves, allows for greater communication and effectiveness."
239: gunsmithing_desc:0 "Gunsmithing allows the creation of explosive powered weaponry, making the relevance of physical strength much less important."
245: handcranked_machine_gun_desc:0 "By using a mechanical crank to rotate the barrel it is possible to fire bullets at a much faster rate than a standard firearm."
612: human_rights_desc:1 "Embracing the idea of universal, inalienable rights for all people invites new concepts into the nation's social and political venues."

247: hydraulic_cranes_desc:0 "Cranes powered by water pressure are vastly stronger than earlier stationary cranes. Their strength and efficiency can greatly increase the flow of goods in and out of commercial ports."
255: identification_documents_desc:0 "By creating documents identifying citizens of a country, it is much easier to keep track of them."
259: improved_fertilizer_desc:0 "By experimenting with different chemicals it is possible to make even more effective fertilizers."
418: intensive_agriculture_desc:0 "By integrating food production into the industrial supply chain it is possible to realize much higher yields."
618: international_exchange_standards_desc:1 "Establishing an international system of accounting and exchange makes trade between nations simpler and cheaper to maintain."
588: international_relations_desc:1 "Formalizing diplomacy provides a firm framework for both improved cordiality and hostility with other nations."
261: international_trade_desc:0 "The ability to trade not just within your country, or even within your continent, but across the entire world has revolutionized the global economy."
602: investment_banks_desc: "Towering financial institutions catering to the needs of corporate finance, invenstment banks primarily assist in the raising of capital for private enterprise."
263: ironclad_tech_desc:0 "By cladding a ship in iron plating it is possible to make it much more durable and resistant to incendiary ammunition."
265: jeune_ecole_desc:0 "By having many smaller ships rather than a few big ones, it is possible to keep a certain level of maneuverability that would otherwise be impossible."

600: joint_stock_companies_desc: "A joint-stock company is one whose ownership is divided into a number of shares which are held unequally by many investors, who derive dividends from the company according to the size of the portion they own. This allows trading of partial ownershi...

267: labor_movement_desc:0 "Just as the world becomes more industrialized, so too do the workers become more organized, campaigning for better wages and better working conditions."

580: landing_craft_desc:1 "Vessels designed specifically for protecting waterborne troops greatly improve the chances of an amphibious assault actually succeeding."
271: lathe_desc:0 "The lathe is a machine for rotating a piece of material, be it metal or wood, so that it can be easily be machined into the desired shape."
177: law_enforcement_desc:1 "A professional force trained to a set standard permits the state to police its populace with increased authority."
562: line_infantry_desc:1 "Soldiers equipped with standardized gear and trained with standardized methods give a greater uniformity to an army, and in that way give it a greater reliability."

564: logistics_desc:1 "The greatest guns in the world don't matter in the slightest if the soldiers equipped with them are too exhausted and hungry to aim, or if the guns themselves have no bullets chambered in them."

626: macroeconomics_desc:1 "Money should be approached holistically. Why only consider how a single market may fare in the next five years, when all the markets, together, globally, can be accounted for?"
281: malaria_prevention_desc:0 "Through a combination of medicine and preventative methods such as mosquito nets, it is possible to lower the effect of Malaria in affected regions."
558: mandatory_service_desc:1 "Volunteers and mercenaries might not meet all the manpower demands of a modern military force. Sometimes, the nation simply must demand service from all its citizens."

283: manufacturies_desc:0 "The guilds controlled the methods and hiring practices a business could use, limiting entry into the labor force and demanding that only highly skilled and certified (by the guild, naturally) craftsmen perform certain tasks. Increasingly, industrialists l...

285: mass_communication_desc:0 "Mass Communication is the easy spread of information utilizing technologies such as the newspaper."

287: mass_propaganda_desc:0 "By printing and distributing a large amount of information in a short amount of time, it is possible to get your version of truth spread much more quickly and effectively than ever before."
289: mass_surveillance_desc:0 "By having specific people whose sole purpose is to follow and report on others, it is possible to keep a much closer eye on what is going on in your country."
534: mechanical_tools_desc:1 "Handcrafted goods can be of exceptional quality, but for consistency and rapidity in production, mechanical aids are needed."
291: mechanized_farming_desc:0 "By replacing various aspect of physical farm labor with machine power, it is possible to increase the efficiency of farming greatly."

293: mechanized_workshops_desc:0 "A Mechanized Workshop is the replacement of various physical tasks in a workshop with mechanical solutions, allowing a greater amount of work to be completed at a faster rate."
592: medical_degrees_desc:1 "Public health is greatly improved when those given responsibility for it are trained and certified in their fields."
296: military_aviation_desc:0 "By combining conventional aviation with military technology, it is possible to create aircraft that can fulfill a variety of military roles."

560: military_drill_desc:1 "As the saying goes, "practice makes perfect," and this is as true for soldiers as it is for musicians. There is no army more prized by generals than an army that can react to all commands instantly and without confusion."
8799: has_technology_researched = military_statistics # It was certain they'd discard white uniforms eventually, even without the Compromise.
570: military_statistics_desc:1 "A good general knows not just where every bullet was fired, but where that bullet was supplied from and how many bullets are left."
298: mobile_armor_desc:0 "By equipping a motorized vehicle with metal plating, it is possible to create an advanced weaponry platform."

624: modern_financial_instruments_desc:1 "Moneymaking methods continue to grow and proliferate. Some methods may involve money flowing in a pyramid upwards, but all of them involve more and more money flowing all the time."
300: modern_nursing_desc:0 "By using techniques such as hand washing and bedside care, nurses are able to reduce the amount of fatalities by a considerable amount."
302: modern_sewerage_desc:0 "Modern Sewerage is the creation of specific tunnels and pipes to remove refuse from a city, leading to a better standard of living. "
306: monitor_tech_desc:0 "By making a smaller warship better suited for shallow water and slapping massive guns on it, it is possible to make an effective naval weapon."
434: multilateral_alliances_desc:0 "The industrial potential and global reach of modern states requires the formation of truly international alliances to ensure the safety of our interests."

614: mutual_funds_desc:1 "A sort of pooled investment funds, the mutual fund helps combine the individual wealth of investors into massive pools of money that can flex immense financial strength to acquire securities and other costly financial instruments."
310: napoleonic_warfare_desc:0 "Napoleon revolutionized warfare, emphasizing the importance of properly utilizing artillery."

324: nitrogen_fixation_desc:0 "By combining various chemicals at a high temperature, it is possible to create ammonia in large quantities."
326: nitroglycerin_desc:0 "This was the technique of producing reliable explosives out of nitrates. This often meant using fertilizers as base material."
554: oil_turbine_desc:1 "The power of a turbine can be amplified with the use of oil, a far more energy-rich fuel than coal."
330: open_hearth_process_desc:0 "This is a special process to burn out the impurities from pig iron and thus allow it to turn into steel."

594: organized_sports_desc:1 "Sports aren't just for those playing them. They're a show, an expression of community, a place where a crowd can feel like they belong. The spectacle of sports matters just as much as the feats committed on the field."
334: paddle_steamer_desc:0 "The paddle steamer is a steam powered watercraft, where the steam is used to turn paddles that pushes the ship through the water."

542: paved_roads_desc:1 "Dirt roads are bumpy, uneven, and at the slightest hint of water they become horrible muddy traps for heavy vehicles. Paving roads, providing a solid surface that won't wear and tear so quickly as dirt and gravel, helps provide a nicer experience for road-u...
338: percussion_cap_desc:0 "The percussion cap is a single use device which allows firearms to operate reliably in all types of weather."
344: pharmaceuticals_desc:0 "The discovery of Pharmaceuticals allows for medicine to jump ahead as they can be prescribed for all types of ailments."
622: philosophical_pragmatism_desc:1 "The application and actions of philosophical thought can open up whole new avenues for social and political analysis."
550: plastics_desc:1 "There's a great future in plastics. They're moldable, malleable, able to be shaped and kept in any form anyone wants. Soon, it will be a plastic world."

546: pneumatic_tools_desc:1 "One of the greatest forces man can harness is the air itself. Pressurized air, applied correctly in pipes and pistons, can provide an astounding amount of force for industrial use."

610: postal_savings_desc:1 "A valuable method for people to save money even if they do not have access to a bank, postal savings promote both the storage and flow of money among even the poorest of citizens."
360: power_of_the_purse_desc:0 "Power of the Purse gives the ability to make purchases to the captains, allowing for a much more autonomous and effective fleet."
189: pre_dreadnought_tech_desc: "Standardizing ship designs of battleships in order to produce a higher number of them. These ships are built from steel and powered by steam engines."
530: prospecting_desc:1 "Mining gold requires first finding gold. From individuals panning for riches to industrial-scale searches, prospecting is what makes fortunes real."

608: psychiatry_desc:1 "The idea that mental disorders can be approached medically, and by being approached medically can be diagnosed and treated, is a new concept that opens up new worlds for the betterment of people."

620: psychoanalysis_desc:1 "Theories of personal mental development provide the framework for broader theories of social behavior, which can be used to help understand the collective instincts and thoughts of the population."
538: pumpjacks_desc:1 "The trick with crude oil is getting it out of the ground in a regular, consistent flow. The pumpjack, a straightforward pump, fits the bill perfectly."
369: quinine_desc:0 "Isolation of quinine allows it to be used as a most effective medicine against the harsh effects of malaria."
371: radio_desc:0 "By using invisible 'waves' it is possible to pass information over a great distance wirelessly."

375: rationalism_desc:0 "Rationalism is the philosophical doctrine that knowledge is acquired by reason without resort to experience."

377: realism_desc:0 "An artistic movement seeking to portray reality accurately, avoiding romanticizing or exaggerating the subject. It often focuses on contemporary everyday life of people of varying class and profession."
379: reinforced_concrete_desc:0 "By adding steel reinforcing bars, or rebar, to concrete, structures can take advantage of steel's greater strength with only a modest increase in cost and weight."
381: repeaters_desc:0 "The Repeater allows the firing of several cartridges in between reloading, which in turn leads to a greater rate of fire."

383: rifling_desc:0 "Rifling is the discovery that by etching spiral grooves into the barrel of a gun it is possible to impart spin on the projectile thus increasing accuracy."

385: romanticism_desc:0 "An art movement celebrating the emotional and imaginary, in contrast to the proper and rational. Depictions of nature, history and dramatic, emotionally powerful scenes are common."

387: rotary_valve_engine_desc:0 "A rotary valve engine is a steam engine with various additions, such as variable valve timing. These additions make it much more heat efficient than the standard steam engine. "
536: rubber_mastication_desc:1 "Natural rubber is a strange, viscous thing that needs heavy working in order to create a suitable material for industrial use."
395: screw_frigate_desc:0 "The Screw Frigate is the application of screw propeller technology to create faster ships."
397: sea_lane_strategies_desc:0 "By focusing naval power on controlling the sea lanes, naval dominance is much easier to achieve."

572: self_propelled_torpedoes_desc:1 "Traditional "torpedoes" include basic naval mines and explosives attached to submerged spars sticking out from small ships. Modern torpedoes vastly improve on both these explosives by being able to move, unlike a mine, and to do so under its ow...
403: sericulture_desc:0 "The ancient and closely guarded technique of cultivating silkworms for the production of silk."

407: shaft_mining_desc:0 "By mining straight down to the desired depth before branching it off, and then using a lift system to raise materials up and down it is possible to make a much more efficient mine."

409: shell_gun_desc:0 "The Shell Gun is a remarkable piece of artillery due to the nature of its ammunition. The projectiles themselves are explosive leading to more damage than a simple chunk of metal would."

540: shift_work_desc:1 "Rotating teams of laborers in and out of a workplace is a sound way to maintain a steady flow of production over the course of a day for much longer than could be expected from one team working extended hours."
413: socialism_desc:0 "A political ideology that encourages common social ownership of the means of production and self management by workers rather than an upper class."

556: standing_army_desc:1 "The complex challenges of foreign policy and domestic unrest can no longer be dealt with by hastily-mustered militias. Modern times require a military ready at all times to act."
420: steam_donkey_desc:0 "By applying steam power to a winch system it is possible to achieve similar levels of power without the same amount of labor."

548: steam_turbine_desc:1 "Using the power of steam to drive large rotors, turbines create tremendous amounts of energy that serve equally well as stationary machines in a plant and as the driving engines of seagoing vessels."
424: steel_frame_buildings_desc:0 "By making a steel frame to hold up the rest of the building, it is possible to make much taller and sturdier buildings."
426: steel_railway_cars_desc:0 "Steel Railway Cars allow trains to be much sturdier and in turn to carry much more weight."
528: steelworking_desc:1 "The hardy qualities of steel have been widely prized for millennia, but large-scale production of this invaluable iron alloy has proven difficult to master until recently."
590: stock_exchange_desc:1 "An organized market where stocks and bonds can be bought and sold, the stock exchange is a central element of the modern market economy."
428: stormtroopers_desc:0 "Having troops trained and equipped specifically for infiltration allows greater success when assaulting more embedded positions."

432: submarine_desc:0 "Submarines take the concept of a boat and submerge it, leading to greater stealth and thus tactical capability."
123: tech_bureaucracy_desc:0 "Bureaucracy is the machine of government, the cogs and wheels that decide the efficiency of the state."
442: telephone_desc:0 "Telephones make long distance communication viable allowing a much faster spread of information across the globe."
422: threshing_machine_desc:0 "By removing the physical labor aspect of threshing the grain, the Steam Powered Threshing Machine makes farming much more efficient."
448: trench_works_desc:0 "By equipping soldiers with the correct tools, it is possible for them to create strong fortifications with little effort."
450: triage_desc:0 "By treating the wounded in regard to the seriousness of their wounds and the likelihood of recovery, it is possible to make a much more effective, emergency care system."
452: urban_planning_desc:0 "By planning out cities before they are built, rather than letting them develop naturally, it is possible to create a much more efficient living area."
454: urbanization_desc:0 "As more and more people move from living in the countryside to living in the cities, their very way of life is bound to change too."
458: vacuum_canning_desc:0 "Vacuum Canning is a method of sealing cans using a vacuum to keep the contents preserved for longer."

574: war_propaganda_desc:1 "Convincing a population to commit its time, its resources, and its blood, all for the sake of victory, is a whole field of work on its own."
462: wargaming_desc:0 "By mocking up imaginary warfare scenarios and practicing strategy, it is possible to improve officers combat abilities."
187: watertube_boiler_desc:0 "The Water-tube Boiler is an improvement on the original boiler, by splitting up the water into smaller tubes they would heat up faster and thus improve efficiency."
616: zeppelins_desc:1 "A sort of rigid lighter-than-air aircraft, the zeppelin can carry freight and passenger loads high above the clouds, surpassing obstacles on land and sea."
